requirements.note: All four server-only types CONNACK/SUBACK/UNSUBACK/PINGRESP are injected in initial/auth-pending/connected/reauth-pending states. Initial unversioned input closes; initial AUTH returns failed CONNACK82; established states return DISCONNECT82. Pipelined PING is discarded. S2C output role assertions inspect every observed frame. This is a 16-case finite state/type matrix, not every invalid byte stream.

Server AUTH constructors only choose18 continuation or00 completion. Actual observed AUTH output is checked against this literal role set; client00 while reauth pending is rejected82. Client19 initiation and18 continuation remain supported; initial successful exchange finishes with CONNACK. Tests use the actual PLAIN exchange and a deterministic local credential policy, not an Argon2 performance assertion.

Reviewed all production server DISCONNECT constructors: fresh Frame::v5(Packet::Disconnect) with no copied received properties; SessionExpiry is only extracted for client-origin disconnect handling. All observed server terminal frames in the new traces assert no SessionExpiry and no client-only Will-request code04. Generic symmetric codec acceptance of a client-only property is not itself a broker emitter defect.

RequestProblemInformation0 is not an instruction to remove forwarded application UserProperty. Actual QoS2 PUBREC/PUBCOMP carry no ReasonString/UserProperty, while subscriber PUBLISH retains the original application property. CONNECT and PUBREL diagnostic markers are not echoed into application data. Production control/AUTH constructors never copy CONNECT/received diagnostic properties; no generated optional diagnostic feature is configured.
Actual RequestResponseInformation0 CONNECT receives no ResponseInformation. The broker does not generate this optional property even when requested; the MAY branch is not claimed implemented.

PUBLISH is bidirectional but SubscriptionIdentifier is broker-owned recipient metadata. The connection worker/model path rejects client-injected identifiers before routing/outbox changes. The role-agnostic codec must still support legitimate server PUBLISH properties; this requirement cannot be reduced to Table2-4 packet position.

Server emission never uses client-only04; observed server reasons82 and existing guarded constructors are valid server codes. A client sending a server-only DISCONNECT reason violates a sender-role rule, but this implementation closes on receipt and does not interpret ServerReference as a redirect. No unspecified mandatory negative-echo behavior is invented for an already terminating client packet. Full receiver-side direction diagnostics remain distinct from sender legality.

Auth-pending violations emit one failed CONNACK, never premature server DISCONNECT; connected violations emit terminal DISCONNECT. EOF immediately follows and the pipelined control is not processed. Initial packets that never negotiate a version close without guessing a CONNACK format.

Deterministic serialized actor trace: begin outgoing QoS2, queue QoS1, takeover/resume, reject stale PUBREC and BeginDelivery, ignore stale Disconnect, preserve replay ID/DUP, reject stale PUBCOMP after current PUBREC, hold ReceiveMaximum1 through valid current PUBCOMP, then expose next QoS1. Generation and outbox state are checked together, not solely enum transitions. This memory-worker trace is supplemented by Quality crash/SQLite evidence, not a physical-power-loss claim.

Existing actual socket/write-ticket tests are reused and rerun in the full crate: QoS2 credit is not released by positive PUBREC; an unwritten ACK does not release inbound credit; stale serials cannot release a reused ID. New actor trace independently checks the model/connection generation side.

Coordinator final-artifact reconciliation: existing alias reconnect/takeover reset method passed as part of the immutable e98f5c... full both-mode suite; source maps remain per-connection and no alias state is persisted.
